question: Alignment checks in Next Measure: build, fold into the auto-inspect spike, or skip?
context: The redline mock shows a dashed left-edge guide tagged aligned spanning 4 elements, an Align role option, and a panel row Left edge alignment / 4 items. But the mock never shows how one gets created, and phase 16.6 draggable alignment guides were built and rejected (you said you did not know when you would use a guide). A check with a verdict is a different value prop from a snapping guide, so it may still earn its place; asking before building per the validate-first rule. Spec: docs/design/next-measure.md section 9.

options.label: Build as an Align measurement role
options.detail: Drag along an edge to create an alignment check: it verifies the elements the line crosses share that edge (edge-map based), renders the mock dashed guide with an aligned / off-by-N tag, and lists in the Measurements panel with an item count.

options.label: Fold into the 16.7 auto-inspect spike
options.detail: No hand tool. Alignment findings (and spacing outliers) come from an analyzer pass over the edge map, scoped by marquee.

options.label: Skip alignment for v1
options.detail: Ship size + spacing roles only; revisit after hover-to-measure and the panel prove out.
